title: Concussion Missiles
caption: Concussion Missiles (V)
game_text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your starfighter. May target a starship for free. Draw destiny (if on a Heroic starfighter, may first use 1 Force to add 3 to total). Target hit if total destiny > defense value.
game_text_lines:
Use 1 Force to deploy on your starfighter. May target
a starship for free. Draw destiny (if on a Heroic
starfighter, may first use 1 Force to add 3 to total).
Target hit if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Originally developed by smugglers and pirates as defense against starfighters. Adapted by the Empire to serve as onboard defense for slow moving bombers.

notes: Group: Everything else. Not unique (no dot; printed card Unrestricted). Normal bottom-half slip (756×454) on the green weapon frame: banner STARSHIP WEAPON; game text 4 lines; no icon column (VS16 sphere only); no inline icons, no credits. Slip text matches the stub. BASE: the stub's 'Decipher base: [[Concussion Missiles]]' is the LIGHT DS2 card; this Dark slip sleeves the Dark DS2 card = wiki 'Concussion Missiles (Dark)' (DS2-D-concussionmissiles.gif) — used that. Printed text was 'Use 1 Force to deploy on your bomber, TIE Defender, freighter or transport. May target a starship for free. Draw destiny. Add 1 when targeting a starfighter or squadron. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.' Lore matches the wiki and the scan. Base scan 350 px; copyright DS2 line ('© LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.', as vs15/60). Modern: VB3-D-concussionmissiles-pre.gif (350, Virtual Block 3; same text as this slip).
